about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Salesperson by vocation, entrepreneur by choice, and forever a learner.
about.bio_1: My name is Kauã Souza and, before any role or title, I'm someone who loves people. Early on I learned that selling isn't pushing a product — it's listening, understanding what someone needs, and truly helping. That vision shaped everything I do today.
about.bio_2: I started early in the digital world: I built online stores, learned marketing hands-on, and in 2023 I worked at Construtora Pacaembu handling leads, campaigns, and conversion. There I saw up close that results come from relationships — not luck.
about.bio_3: Today I live on three fronts: I'm a salesperson at Loog.ai, a Brazilian AI-powered logistics platform; I'm the CEO of Facility, where we understand each client's needs and deliver the system they're looking for; and I create YouTube content about travel and personal growth.
about.bio_4: Programming? It's a hobby I enjoy — it helps me understand product and talk shop with any technical team. But my game is different: people, business, and constant evolution. My focus is growing 1% every day and bringing as many people along as I can.
